summary: Executive Launchpad Home Hub streamlining plan: Declutters the Home screen by establishing a high-clarity 3-zone architecture—an authoritative executive hero banner retaining the prominent brand crest logo, an institutional 4-metric territory pulse strip, and a centerpiece Top 5 Immediate Priority Opportunities table with 1-click clinical/CAD/dossier launches. Offloads the 4-phase onboarding walkthrough, fast-action checklist, and tactical competitive battlecards into an on-demand slide-over drawer and guided modal so the primary workspace remains calm, focused, and free of visual noise.
